customManagers.description: podman quadlet images on the stateful-service VMs. The argocd manager only looks at clusters/, so an image stops being tracked the moment it moves out of a Helm chart onto a VM — three after phase 2, eight after phase 3. Splitting currentDigest out of currentValue is load-bearing: uptime-kuma is pinned tag@sha256:digest, and a regex that swallows the digest into currentValue turns the version into '2.4.0@sha256:...' and the update proposal into nonsense. Deliberately unanchored — renovate compiles matchStrings with the 'g' flag only, so a '^' would match at the start of the file rather than the start of a line.
